column3: Ayase Route ・ Normal End
I'm home!
Ah, yeah.
As I got home, Kirino was reading a thin book in the living room.
Hey, that's...
A book I bought at 【Summer Comiket】 earlier today.
I knew it. Just because our parents aren't home, you don't have to be so reckless.
Yeah yeah.
Anyway, where were you today?
Had some stuff to do.
Hmm... Well, whatever.
Anyway, come to my room for a moment.
Why?
Just come. There's many things I need to... show you.
I have a bad feeling about this.
Well, she's probably just going to show me today's spoils anyway.
Fine, can't be helped then.
Hehe, it's really awesome, so you'd better look forward to it!
As such, our daily lives, which had been so strange not too long ago, continued like always.
It's not that bad.
Maybe this would have changed if I had made a different choice at some point.
But that is something that I, who can't travel back in time, will never know.
